programs.title: Inside Royal Kensington and Chelsea
programs.desc: The creators invite you for a walk around Knightsbridge, a wealthy street in London, famous for its Victorian mansions and luxury shops and restaurants.The program also includes a visit to Kensington Palace.

programs.title: The Truth about Alcohol
programs.desc: British doctor Javid Abdelmoneim shows the impact of alcoholic beverages on our body and the risks associated with their consumption.To present the harmful effects of alcohol, he uses the latest research results.It explains, among other things, why some people get drunk faster.It also verifies the common opinion that drinking wine is good for your health, and whether a drink before going to bed actually makes you sleep better.We will also learn what effect alcohol has on our stomachs and the feeling of hunger.

programs.title: 10 Ways to Lose 10 Years
programs.desc: Image experts will share their knowledge about fashion and beauty.Thanks to them, viewers will see that you can look beautiful at any age.A few tricks will make anyone feel younger.

programs.title: Inside Dubai: Playground of the Rich
programs.desc: The luxurious life of millionaires and billionaires living in the tax haven of the United Arab Emirates.The creators of the documentary also present profiles of people who serve as their servants.

programs.title: Inside Monaco: Playground of the Rich
programs.desc: The history of the principality where the most millionaires in the world live.The producers look behind the scenes of the royal palace and follow the life of Prince Albert II, who rules this unique country.
